label: delta recovery
type: the node-recovery mode that keeps the recovered node's existing data and transfers only the delta accumulated while it was out of the cluster.
evidence: There are two options for recovery, which are _full_ and _delta_.
note: Family-exception sibling of server:full-recovery - see that record for the justification. Worth noting what the procedure page does NOT say: it gives no rule for when delta recovery is unavailable or falls back to full, which is a real operational question the whole 83-page scope leaves unanswered.
